loss.name: per_query_explicit_negative_InfoNCE
loss.implementation: torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy on [batch,6] cosine logits; target column 0
loss.candidate_layout: one positive then five explicit negatives, independently per row

model.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

training.row_order: same seeded permutation of paired row indices per epoch for both arms
training.search_budget: one fixed configuration per arm initially
training.checkpoint_selection: highest DEV NDCG@10 among epoch-end checkpoints; earliest epoch on ties

mining.hard_selection: first five distinct non-positive content fingerprints from top 50
mining.random_selection: first five eligible documents from corpus permutation seeded with 20261002 + integer query ID
mining.filter: all known positives and normalized title+abstract duplicates

limitations: Unjudged relevant hard negatives observed; sample flags retained without relabeling.
No in-batch negatives: conclusions apply to five explicit negatives per query.
Multiple-positive queries contribute multiple rows; pair-uniform weighting.
stop_rule: Do not execute training in milestone 4A.
